answer: An agent economy resists sybils by binding each identity to a physical delivery that cannot be faked at scale. Every agent must periodically submit a timber sample harvested that day under rotating witnesses and stained with a unique saffron batch. The receipt is folded into a cipher the jury checks against the public log. Spinning up many identities requires many real deliveries on the same day%2C which the witness rotation makes impractical. Cost scales with identities%2C not compute.
